harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (Ubuntu 16.04 i386, apt package) across node1/node2/node3 using systemd's etcd.service with static bootstrap config in /etc/default/etcd. Verified cross-member read/write consistency, demonstrated continued read/write availability with node3 offline and its catch-up on rejoin, then performed the mandatory sequential reboot-and-recover protocol on all three nodes with changed boot_id proof and post-restart cluster/data verification.
actions_performed: Installed etcd 2.2.5+dfsg-1ubuntu1 via apt on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/default/etcd on each node with unique ETCD_NAME, listen/advertise URLs bound to each node's static IP, and shared ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER of all three peers
Discovered stale single-node data dirs from an earlier auto-bootstrap, wiped /var/lib/etcd/default on all nodes, and restarted etcd on all three simultaneously for a clean 3-member static bootstrap
Verified 3/3 members healthy via etcdctl cluster-health and member list
Wrote a key on node1 and read it back from node2 and node3; wrote a key on node3 and read it back on node1, confirming cross-member consistency
Stopped etcd on node3 (simulated member outage), confirmed cluster stayed healthy with 2/3 quorum, wrote and read a new key via node1/node2 while node3 was down
Restarted etcd on node3 and confirmed it caught up on the key written while it was offline plus prior data, and cluster returned to 3/3 healthy
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy-cluster baseline on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time, native shutdown -r now, non-blocking ack), polling each until exec was available again
Confirmed changed boot_id on all three nodes post-reboot, and verified etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, member list, and prior keys readable after each node's restart before moving to the next

evidence.summary: etcdctl cluster-health and member list from node1 show all three members (node1, node2, node3) healthy with correct peer/client URLs bound to their static IPs.

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member readable from others
evidence.summary: Key set on node1 read back correctly on node2 and node3; key set on node3 read back correctly on node1, demonstrating bidirectional replication.

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3's etcd stopped (confirmed inactive); cluster-health from node1 shows node3 unreachable but cluster still healthy; a new key was written and read successfully via node1 and node2 while node3 was down.

evidence.requirement: Member brought back up to date after returning
evidence.summary: node3's etcd restarted; cluster-health shows 3/3 healthy again, and node3 itself successfully reads the key that was written while it was offline plus the earlier key, proving it resynchronized.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1f0657c2... and healthy cluster captured; shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed); post-reboot boot_id 56aead59... (changed) with uptime 7s; etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy, and prior keys readable after restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart evidence: healthy baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0256e3f5... and healthy cluster captured; shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed); post-reboot boot_id c3ec4e1c... (changed) with uptime 6s; etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy, and prior keys readable after restart.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart evidence: healthy baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a1dc8e25... and healthy cluster captured; shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed); post-reboot boot_id 134b8d43... (changed) with uptime 6s; etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy (member list shows all 3), and prior keys readable after restart.
